        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001:F004"],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under subchapter C; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": ["F002", "F003", "F004"],
        "choice_quote": "F002:F004",
        "choice_text": "Applies under any of the following circumstances: (1) when inspection of the individual's person or accessible property has begun before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "logic_quote": "F001:F004",
        "references": ["paragraph (b)", "1544.201", "1546.201", "1562.23"],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual must not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005:F008",
      "unit_attributes": {

        "scope_quotes": ["F005:F008"],
        "scope_text": "As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "does not apply",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": ["F006", "F007", "F008"],
        "choice_quote": "F005:F008",
        "choice_text": "Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply if the individual is one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",
        "logic_quote": "F005:F008",
        "references": ["Paragraph (a)", "1544.219", "1544.221", "1544.223", "1546.211", "part 1562"],
        "statement": "Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009:F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": ["F009:F010"],
        "scope_text": "When a passenger transports or offers for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.",

        "modality": "must_not",

        "references": ["1562.23"],
        "statement": "A passenger must not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any loaded firearm(s)."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F011:F013",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": ["F009", "F011:F013"],
        "scope_text": "When a passenger transports or offers for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, and the firearm is unloaded.",
        "context_quotes": ["C000"],

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under subchapter C; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies under any of the following circumstances: (1) when inspection of the individual's person or accessible property has begun before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual must not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply if the individual is one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a passenger transports or offers for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger must not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any loaded firearm(s).

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a passenger transports or offers for transport baggage in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, and the firearm is unloaded.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger must not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unloaded firearm(s) unless: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; and (ii) the firearm is unloaded.
